notes.name: NVP, the navigation pod as the SMS lists it (ours, inferred: the dash-34's mnemonic was not found)
notes.kind: the LANTIRN navigation pod, AN/AAQ-13: a terrain-following radar and a forward-looking infrared camera whose picture shows on the HUD (fas-lantirn); the F-16I Sufa's (iaf-f16i). Its FLIR picture on the HUD and its TFR's terrain following (automatic and manual TF, the fly-ups) are shared/weapons/nav_pod.gd (modern-iaf/docs/weapons.md §7.4)
notes.drag: carriage drag index (flight-model.md §9.18): 0.15 x its 0.305 m across (w-lantirn) frontal area, 0.15 the drag of a streamlined pod on its pylon on that area (inferred, as the tanks' and the Litening's)
notes.model: our LANTIRN navigation pod (shared/extra/models/stores/lantirn.glb: FlightGear's AN-AAQ-13 at the real 1.99 m, w-lantirn)
notes.generation: ours: the weapons.ibx section key (generation · 1000 + type) is one per weapon of a kind (the tanks hold 0 and 1, the Litening 2)
notes.station: the left chin hardpoint, 5L (f16net-lantirn: the navigation pod on 5L); the sim's pylon J (sim.rs F16_SIM_STATIONS StationJ)

footnotes.w-lantirn: Wikipedia, "LANTIRN" (the AN/AAQ-13 navigation pod: 199 cm long, 30 cm across, 204.6 kg), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LANTIRN
footnotes.fas-lantirn: FAS Military Analysis Network, "LANTIRN" (the navigation pod: 1.99 m, 0.31 m, 211.5 kg; its TFR and FLIR on the HUD), https://man.fas.org/dod-101/sys/smart/lantirn.htm
footnotes.iaf-f16i: Israeli Air Force site, "F-16I הדור הבא" (the F-16I carries the LANTIRN navigation pod and the Litening beneath its air intake), https://www.iaf.org.il/522-19034-he/IAF.aspx (as the search engine returned it; modern-iaf/docs/research/pods.md §1)
footnotes.f16net-lantirn: F-16.net, "AN/AAQ-13 & AN/AAQ-14 LANTIRN" (the navigation pod on 5L), https://www.f-16.net/f-16_armament_article2.html
